senses.gloss:
धिक् धिक्, ind. (said to be connected with
rt. 1. दिह्), an interjection of reproach, menace or
displeasure, = fie! shame! out upon! what a pity!
&c.; (generally followed by the acc., sometimes by
the nom. or voc., and rarely by the gen., e. g. धिक्
त्वाम्, shame upon thee! धिग् इयम् दरिद्रता,
shame upon this poverty!)
—धिक्-पारुष्य, अम्,
n. abuse, reproach, excessive reviling.
—धिग्-दण्ड,
अस्, m. reprimand, censure.

धिक्-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, -कर्तुम्, to reproach,
censure, reprimand, curse (with acc.).
—धिक्-कार,
अस्, m. or धिक्-क्रिया, f. reproach, contempt, cen-
sure, disrespect.
—धिक्-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, reproached,
reviled, censured, condemned, cursed; (अम्), n. a
reproach, contempt, curse.

धिक्ष् धिक्ष् (perhaps a Desid. form of
rt. 1. दह्, cf. rt. धुक्ष्), cl. 1. A.
धिक्षते, &c., to kindle; to live; to be weary or
harassed.

धीक्ष् धीक्ष् (perhaps Desid. of rt. 1.
दिह्), cl. 1. A. धीक्षते, &c., Ved. to
wish to anoint.
